standingPayment.markRefusedRegister: The paid mark was not saved: a payment journal from an earlier mark is still standing on the ledger even though this PO reads unpaid. err.GRN_APPROVAL_PENDING: The payment status was saved, but no payment journal was posted — payables and bank are both untouched. One of this PO's receipts is still awaiting the owner's decision. Have the owner approve or decline it first, then unmark payment and mark it paid again.
err.GRN_JOURNALS_INCOMPLETE: The payment status was saved, but no payment journal was posted — payables and bank are both untouched. One of this PO's receipts has no GRN journal. Post the missing GRN journal from its GRN row, then unmark payment and mark it paid again.
err.GRN_REVERSAL_MISSING: The payment status was saved, but no payment journal was posted — payables and bank are both untouched. A receipt was declined by the owner and its GRN journal was never reversed. Post the reversal journal from the declined GRN's row, then unmark payment and mark it paid again.
err.AP_ACCOUNT_MISMATCH: The payment status was saved, but no payment journal was posted — payables and bank are both untouched. The receipts booked their payable to a different account than the AP posting role now resolves to. Check the AP account mapping in Account Mapping, then unmark payment and mark it paid again.
err.PAYMENT_SUPERSEDED: The payment status was saved, but a payment journal from an earlier mark is still standing for a different amount than this PO now owes, so no new journal was posted. Payables and bank are NOT untouched here — they still hold that earlier payment, which no longer clears this PO's payable. Unmark payment, confirm in Finance that the reversal journal actually posted this time, then mark it paid again. If that reversal fails too, this PO raises a standing-payment warning with a button that posts the reversal directly.
err.UNMAPPED_ROLE: The payment status was saved, but no payment journal was posted — payables and bank are both untouched. The posting role "{role}" is not mapped to an account. Map it in Account Mapping, then unmark payment and mark it paid again.
err.NOTHING_TO_POST: The PO was marked paid, but no payable was found booked to the GL for it, so no journal was posted — payables and bank are both untouched. Confirm this PO should be marked paid at all; if a receipt is missing, receive it first, then unmark payment and mark it paid again.

UNBALANCED.payment: The payment status was saved, but the payment journal was unbalanced (debit ≠ credit) so it was not posted — payables and bank are both untouched. Check this PO's journals in Finance, then unmark payment and mark it paid again.
UNBALANCED.reversal: The paid mark was removed, but its reversal journal was unbalanced (debit ≠ credit) so it was not posted. Payables and bank are NOT untouched here — the earlier payment journal is still standing, so payables are cleared and bank is credited for a PO that now reads unpaid. This PO shows a standing-payment warning; post the reversal from the button on that warning.

GENERIC.payment: The payment status was saved, but the payment journal failed to post because of an unexpected error. Check this PO's journals and the account mapping in Finance; if the payment journal really is missing, unmark payment and mark it paid again.
GENERIC.reversal: The paid mark was removed, but its reversal journal failed to post because of an unexpected error, so the earlier payment journal is most likely still standing — payables cleared and bank credited for a PO that now reads unpaid. Check this PO's journals in Finance; if the standing-payment warning is shown on this PO, post the reversal from the button on it.

ANALOGOUS.name: Analogous

MONOCHROMATIC.name: Monochromatic
MONOCHROMATIC.hint: One hue at several strengths and brightnesses. Clean and elegant, but text needs a clear light–dark difference.

TRIAD.name: Triad
TRIAD.hint: Three hues evenly spaced on the wheel. Lively and balanced — let one colour lead.

COMPLEMENTARY.name: Complementary
COMPLEMENTARY.hint: A colour and its opposite across the wheel. The loudest pairing — good for calls to action and promo price tags.

SPLIT_COMPLEMENTARY.name: Split Complementary
SPLIT_COMPLEMENTARY.hint: The base plus the two neighbours of its opposite. Still contrasting, softer than complementary.

SQUARE.name: Square
SQUARE.hint: Four hues a quarter-turn apart. The busiest — suits colourful campaigns.

COMPOUND.name: Compound
COMPOUND.hint: Neighbours mixed with opposites. Rich, but still under control.

SHADES.name: Shades
SHADES.hint: Exactly the same colour at different brightness. The safest for layered backgrounds.

CUSTOM.name: Custom
CUSTOM.hint: Each colour moves on its own. Editing any colour other than the base switches here automatically.

incomeStatement.subtitle: Revenue, cost of goods sold, and expenses for the selected period.
incomeStatement.sectionEmpty: No accounts with a balance in this section yet.
incomeStatement.coverageBody: This report covers only transactions that produce journals: marketplace sales, returns, settlements, goods receipts (GRN), finished-goods receipts, stock opname adjustments, and manual journals. NOT yet included: field sales (putus), van sales, SPG sales, and supplier payments.

balanceSheet.subtitle: Assets, liabilities, and equity as of the selected date.
balanceSheet.sectionEmpty: No accounts with a balance in this section yet.

balanceSheet.unbalancedNote: Assets do NOT equal Liabilities + Equity. This indicates corrupted journal data — inspect the ledger.
balanceSheet.openingBody: The earliest journal is dated {date}. This position covers only journals from that date onward. Record a manual opening-balance journal (cash, receivables, inventory, payables, equity) dated before it so the balance sheet reflects the real position.

cashFlow.empty: No journals in this period yet.
cashFlow.noCashAccountBody: A cash flow statement cannot be produced without a cash account. Map the BANK or CASH role under Finance → Account Mapping, or mark an account as Cash under Cash Flow Classification.
cashFlow.unclassifiedBody: {count} accounts have not been assigned to operating, investing, or financing activities, so they are shown separately. Totals remain correct.
cashFlow.reconciledNote: The computed change in cash equals the actual movement in cash balances. Every journal is validated as balanced when posted, so this agreement is expected — this check only detects corrupt data.
cashFlow.unreconciledNote: The computed change in cash does NOT equal the actual movement in cash balances. This indicates corrupt journal data — check the general ledger.
cashFlow.coverageBody: This report is built from general-ledger journals using the indirect method. Its coverage matches the income statement: it does NOT yet include field sales (putus/konsi) or SPG sales.

desc.INVENTORY_VAN: Stock currently loaded on a canvasser's van; debited when the van is loaded, credited when sold or returned.

desc.AR: Asset account for amounts owed by customers/marketplaces.

desc.INVENTORY_VARIANCE: Account for recording stock opname/reconciliation variances.

receivables.pageDescription: Unpaid store billing. A receivable only drops once finance matches the payment claim against the bank statement.
receivables.emptyBody: A receivable appears on its own once a billing note is issued from a putus delivery, or can be brought in by Excel import for sales made outside Elorae.
receivables.reasonKlaim: You reported a transfer via {no}. Finance has not seen the money land yet, so it does not count as settled.
receivables.reasonTertahan: Held by return {nilai} — the return deduction does not match what the warehouse received. The balance cannot reach zero until the shortfall is settled.
receivables.reasonLewat: The shop promised {tgl} — {hari} days past and no money has arrived. Chase it and get a new date.
receivables.reasonTt: Handed over ({no}). The shop promised {tgl} — wait for the date.
receivables.reasonBelum: Ready to hand over — no return hanging and nothing overdue.

payments.pageDescription: Transfer claims reported by sales. A receivable only drops once finance matches it against the bank statement.
payments.rejectBody: Sales reads the reason on their phone. Say what is wrong and what they should do — without it they will chase the same place again.
payments.rejectPlaceholder: e.g. money has not landed as of today, ask the shop to resend the transfer proof
payments.emptyBody: Claims appear here once sales reports from the field that a shop has transferred.
payments.okVerified: Claim verified — the receivable has been recomputed.
payments.okRejected: Claim rejected. Sales will see the reason.
payments.errTANPA_AKSES: Only finance may decide a claim.
payments.errTIDAK_DITEMUKAN: Claim not found — it may have been deleted.
payments.errSUDAH_DIPUTUSKAN: This claim was already decided. Reload the page.
payments.errGAGAL: Could not save the decision. Try again.
payments.newBody: A report that the shop has transferred. This does NOT reduce the receivable — finance matches it against the bank statement.
payments.sectionInvoicesHint: Tick the invoices, then enter how much if it is not the full amount.
payments.sectionDeductionsHint: A deduction that comes from a return must be linked to its return note — that link is what holds the amount until the warehouse finishes counting.
payments.proofHint: Match the figure in the transfer photo against the bank statement before verifying.
payments.noOpenInvoices: This shop has no open invoices.
payments.deductionReturnHint: A deduction linked to a return note is held in full until the warehouse counts, then only the shortfall is held until somebody bears it.
payments.transferPhotoHint: Required. This is what finance matches against the bank statement.
payments.breakdownPhotoHint: Optional. The shop's own working sheet, if there is one.
payments.negativeReceived: Deductions exceed the invoice value. Check the figures.
payments.claimNotSettled: Until this is verified, the receivable does not drop by a single rupiah.
payments.heldExplain: Verified, but {value} is not recognised — the return deduction does not match what the warehouse received.
payments.okClaimCreated: {doc} sent. Waiting for finance to verify.
payments.errTANGGAL_TIDAK_VALID: The transfer date could not be read.
payments.errTANPA_PIUTANG: Pick the invoices being settled first.
payments.errPIUTANG_TIDAK_DITEMUKAN: One of the invoices no longer exists. Reload this page.
payments.errBEDA_TOKO: One claim covers one shop only.
payments.errSUDAH_LUNAS: One of the invoices turns out to be settled. Reload this page.
payments.errMELEBIHI_SISA: One invoice is being settled for more than it has outstanding.
payments.errNILAI_TIDAK_VALID: One of the figures is not valid.
payments.errRETUR_TIDAK_DITEMUKAN: The chosen return note no longer exists.
payments.errRETUR_BEDA_TOKO: That return note belongs to a different shop.
payments.errFOTO_WAJIB: The transfer receipt photo is required.
payments.errNOMOR_BENTROK: The claim number clashed. Try sending again.
payments.errJENIS_BUTUH_RETUR: A deduction of this type must be linked to a return note.
payments.errJENIS_HANYA_PKP: This deduction is for PKP stores only. Mark the store as PKP first if that is correct.
payments.errJENIS_BUTUH_CATATAN: A deduction of this type must have an explanation.
payments.voidBody: For a claim that was ENTERED WRONG — wrong invoice, wrong amount, wrong return link. Different from rejecting, which means the money genuinely was not in the account. The row is kept, and the receivable is recomputed.
payments.voidPlaceholder: e.g. wrong invoice picked, re-entered on another claim
payments.why_DIBATALKAN: This report was voided because it was entered wrong, not because the money was missing.
payments.relinkBody: Change which return note the deduction “{nama}” points at, or unlink it. This changes how much is held, so the receivable is recomputed.
payments.danglingRow: the return note it points at no longer exists
payments.danglingWarning: A deduction points at a return note that no longer exists. Its value is held in full against the receivable — the safe direction — but it will never be released until the link is corrected with “Re-link”.
payments.okClaimQueued: Saved on the phone. The report sends by itself once there is a signal.
payments.errKUNCI_DIPAKAI: This report clashes with another salesperson's. Make a new report.
payments.photoHint_transfer: Required. This is what finance matches against the bank statement.
payments.photoHint_tunai: Required. The receipt signed and stamped by the store, as proof the cash was handed over.
payments.photoHint_giro: Required. A photo of the slip itself, with its number and dates readable.
payments.sectionGiroHint: A giro is not money yet. The receivable only drops once the giro clears into the account.
payments.giroEffectiveHint: No later than {date} — a giro slip is valid for 70 days from its issue date.
payments.claimNotSettledGiro: A giro is not money yet: the receivable does not drop at all until the giro clears into the account.
payments.errGIRO_TANGGAL_WAJIB: Enter both the issue date and the effective date.
payments.errGIRO_EFEKTIF_SEBELUM_TERBIT: The effective date cannot be before the issue date.
payments.errGIRO_LEWAT_MASA_BERLAKU: The effective date is past the giro validity period: at most 70 days from the issue date (Bank Indonesia regulation PBI 18/41/PBI/2016). The bank would refuse this giro.
payments.errGIRO_BELUM_CAIR: This giro has not cleared yet. Mark it cleared from the giro list once the money is in the account.
payments.errBUKAN_GIRO_MENUNGGU: This giro was already decided. Reload the page.
payments.needDeduction: Fill in the name and amount of every deduction.
payments.needPhoto: Fill in the "{label}" box — the photo is required.
payments.salinan: Copied from {doc}. The date, payment method and photos (if any) are filled in — choose the right store, then tick its invoices.
payments.errPENGGANTI_TIDAK_DITEMUKAN: The payment report to replace was not found.
payments.errPENGGANTI_MASIH_BERLAKU: The old payment report is still active. Withdraw or cancel it before reporting again.
payments.errPENGGANTI_BUKAN_MILIK: The old payment report is not yours.
payments.errSUDAH_DIGANTI: The old payment report already has a replacement — the same money cannot be reported twice.
payments.errTOKO_TIDAK_DIIZINKAN: These invoices are not yours to collect — the store is held by another salesperson. Ask the office to assign the collection to you.

collections.finishBlocked: Some invoices on this note are still unpaid.
collections.cancelBody: The invoices become free again and can go onto another note. Write down why, so it does not become an argument later.
collections.cancelPlaceholder: For example: invoices taken back, shop refused to sign
collections.createBody: Pick the shop, then which invoices were handed over. A collection note does not reduce the receivable — it only records that the shop is holding the invoice.
collections.receivedByPlaceholder: Name of the person at the shop who signed
collections.emptyBody: A collection note is created when physical invoices are handed to a shop.
collections.errTANPA_AKSES: You do not have access to create or close collection notes.
collections.errTANGGAL_TIDAK_VALID: The handover or promised date could not be read.
collections.errTANPA_PIUTANG: Pick the invoices being handed over first.
collections.errPIUTANG_TIDAK_DITEMUKAN: One of the invoices no longer exists. Reload this page.
collections.errBEDA_TOKO: One collection note covers one shop only.
collections.errSUDAH_LUNAS: One of the invoices turns out to be settled. Reload this page.
collections.errSUDAH_DI_KONTRABON: One of the invoices is already held by the shop on another note.
collections.errJANJI_SEBELUM_SERAH: The promised date cannot come before the handover date.
collections.errNOMOR_BENTROK: The note number clashed with one just created. Try saving again.
collections.errSUDAH_DITUTUP: This collection note is already closed.
collections.errMASIH_ADA_SISA: Some invoices on this note are still unpaid.
collections.invoicesHint: The value at handover never changes — it is printed on the paper. Outstanding now is recomputed from claims.
collections.photoHint: The sheet the shop signed. Photographed once the paper comes back from the field.
collections.noPhoto: No photo of the signed sheet yet.
collections.claimsEmpty: No payment report points at this collection note yet.
collections.confirmBody: Match the photo of the sheet signed by the store against the invoices and the promised date. Confirming does not change the receivable — it states the office has checked this promise. The salesperson who recorded it will be told.
collections.okConfirmed: Payment promise confirmed. The salesperson will be told.
collections.confirmedBy: Recorded by the salesperson in the field; confirmed by {name}, {date}.
collections.fieldUnconfirmedExplain: Recorded by the salesperson in the field and already in effect for collection, but not yet confirmed by the office. Match the photo of the signed receipt against the invoices below, then press Confirm.
collections.emptyUnconfirmedBody: Every payment promise from the field has been confirmed by the office.
collections.cancelFieldHint: This promise was recorded by a salesperson in the field — they will receive this reason.
collections.errBUKAN_DARI_LAPANGAN: This note was made by the office; there is nothing to confirm.
collections.errSUDAH_DIKONFIRMASI: This note is already confirmed. Reload the page.
collections.errBUKAN_PENAGIH: Some invoices are not collected by this salesperson.
collections.errFOTO_WAJIB: A photo of the signed receipt is required.
collections.errPENERIMA_WAJIB: Enter the name of the person at the store who received it.
collections.errKUNCI_DIPAKAI: This report clashes with another salesperson report. Create a new report.

storeReturns.pageDescription: One list for every return. Each row names the next step and whose turn it is.
storeReturns.summary: {count} to work on · {held} held back from receivables
storeReturns.flow1Body: Number and contents copied from the shop's own note. The number is theirs, not ours.
storeReturns.flow2Body: Counts what actually arrived. Until it is counted, the return deduction is not recognised at all.
storeReturns.flow3Body: If less arrived than the shop claimed, decide who bears it. Until then the invoice stays open.
storeReturns.effectKeputusan: the difference holds the invoice open
storeReturns.effectCek: the return deduction is not recognised
storeReturns.effectJodoh: goods arrived with no shop note
storeReturns.whyKeputusan: The warehouse received less than the shop claimed. That difference holds the invoice open until somebody is named to bear it.
storeReturns.whyCek: The goods are not recorded as received. While that is empty, the return deduction on the payment claim counts for nothing.
storeReturns.whyJodoh: Goods arrived with no shop note. They must be matched to one before anything can be compared.
storeReturns.whyBeres: Claim and physical agree, or the difference has been assigned.
storeReturns.whyBatal: The note was withdrawn. Deductions already pointing at it stay held in full.
storeReturns.noNrtHint: Copy it exactly from the shop's note. This is the number you will look for in the archive.
storeReturns.createBody: What the shop says it returned. Until the warehouse counts, the whole amount is held back from the receivable — a return is recognised at the physical amount, not the claimed one.
storeReturns.countBody: {doc} — the shop claims {claimed}. Enter the value of what actually arrived.
storeReturns.receiveOrphanTitle: Receive goods with no shop note
storeReturns.receiveOrphanBody: The goods arrived ahead of the note. Record it now, match it once the note turns up.
storeReturns.countHint: Zero is valid and means nothing arrived. That is different from not yet counted, and it can only be recorded once.
storeReturns.pairBody: {doc}, worth {value}. Pick the shop note it belongs to.
storeReturns.pairNoCandidates: No shop note is waiting for a warehouse count.
storeReturns.compareTitle: Shop's claim against the warehouse count
storeReturns.compareHint: Red figures are goods that did not arrive as claimed.
storeReturns.noPhoto: No photo of the note yet. The photo is what the archive is made of.
storeReturns.warehousePending: The warehouse has not counted. While that is empty, the return deduction counts for nothing.
storeReturns.perItemHint: An item that did not arrive at all appears only on the claim side.
storeReturns.chargeOpenBody: The shop took {claimed} off the payment; the warehouse received {counted}. Until this is decided the invoice stays open and the salesman sees a “return held” flag.
storeReturns.chargeCompanyHint: “The company bears it” means the money is written off — pick it only when there is genuinely nobody to charge.
storeReturns.assignBody: The {gap} difference will be borne by {who}. This releases the invoice; recovering it runs on its own.
storeReturns.assignPlaceholder: e.g. deduct from next month's commission
storeReturns.markSettledHint: Does not change the receivable — the invoice was released when the difference was assigned.
storeReturns.usedInClaims: Used as a deduction on payment claims
storeReturns.usedInClaimsEmpty: This note has not been used to reduce any payment yet, so it is holding nothing.
storeReturns.cancelBody: Deductions already pointing at this note do NOT disappear — if the shop has already taken it off a payment, that money is still short and still owed. A cancelled note reads as zero physical, so its deductions are held in full until somebody corrects them.
storeReturns.emptyBody: Every return is settled, or no note has been recorded yet.
storeReturns.errTANPA_AKSES: You do not have access to this action.
storeReturns.errTANGGAL_TIDAK_VALID: The date could not be read.
storeReturns.errNOMOR_SUDAH_DIPAKAI: That note number is already used for this shop.
storeReturns.errSUDAH_DIHITUNG: This note already has a warehouse count. Unmatch it first if the count is wrong.
storeReturns.errBUKAN_YATIM: This receipt already has a match.
storeReturns.errBEDA_TOKO: This receipt is recorded against a different shop. If the shop is wrong, move it first with Move store.
storeReturns.errTIDAK_ADA_SELISIH: There is no difference to assign.
storeReturns.errSUDAH_DIPUTUSKAN: The difference has already been assigned.
storeReturns.errBEBAN_SUDAH_DIPUTUSKAN: The difference has been assigned — it can no longer be unmatched, cancelled or moved.
storeReturns.errBELUM_DIPUTUSKAN: The difference has not been assigned yet.
storeReturns.errSUDAH_LUNAS: This charge is already marked paid back.
storeReturns.errNOMOR_BENTROK: The number clashed with one just created. Try saving again.
storeReturns.itemsHint: May be left empty when only the total was recorded. Without detail all you see later is THAT there is a shortfall — not which item is short.
storeReturns.stockHint: Items picked from the catalogue will ADD to warehouse stock when this count is saved. Rows with only a typed name do not move stock.
storeReturns.photoHint: Required. These photos are what the archive is made of — a note without one leaves only a figure you cannot show the shop.
storeReturns.bearerPersonHint: A charge attaches to a person, not a role — that is what makes it appear on their screen and deductible from their commission.
storeReturns.moveBody: For a note recorded against the wrong store. The note, its warehouse count and any undecided difference move with it. Stock does not change — the goods did arrive. The reporting salesperson is notified.
storeReturns.moveCountBody: For a warehouse count recorded against the wrong store or no store. Once moved, it can be matched with a note from the target store. Stock does not change.
storeReturns.moveReasonPlaceholder: e.g. the salesperson picked the wrong store
storeReturns.okMoved: Note moved to the target store.
storeReturns.cancelCounted: The warehouse has already counted this note's goods and stock has gone up, so it cannot simply be cancelled. If the store is wrong, move it to the right store. If the count is wrong, unmatch it first.
storeReturns.errTOKO_SAMA: The target store is the current store.
storeReturns.errTOKO_TIDAK_AKTIF: The target store is no longer active.
storeReturns.errNOMOR_DIPAKAI_DI_TUJUAN: The target store already has an open note with the same number. If that one is correct, cancel this note instead.
storeReturns.errDIPAKAI_DI_BKM: This note is used as a deduction in {docNo}. Fix that payment report first (cancel it, or unlink the deduction).
storeReturns.errSUDAH_BERPASANGAN: This count is already matched to a note — move it through the note.
storeReturns.moveCountReasonPlaceholder: e.g. the warehouse picked the wrong store when counting
storeReturns.lockedCycleBody: This warehouse count falls in a month already locked in consignment cycle {cycles}. Moving it also changes that month's consigned stock in both stores, and printed reports may differ from the screen.
storeReturns.errSIKLUS_TERKUNCI: This month is locked in a consignment cycle — confirmation needed.

storeReturns.errADA_BUKU_TOKO: This note has already taken goods off the store's stock book, so it cannot move to another store. Cancel it, then record it again at the right store.
storeReturns.perVariantHint: Per item and variant. Condition: store claim → warehouse count. Only sellable goods go back into sellable stock.

foto.errTANPA_AKSES: Your session expired. Sign in again.

arsipRetur.summary: {count} notes · {orphan} warehouse receipts with no note
arsipRetur.hangingExplain: A <tautan>red dot</tautan> on a folder means a note inside it is still hanging — not counted by the warehouse, not matched, or its difference not yet assigned.
arsipRetur.emptyFolderBody: This shop has never sent anything back.

imporPiutang.pageDescription: Upload an Excel or CSV file. Reviewed first, saved second — nothing goes in before you have seen it.
imporPiutang.pickFile: Choose an Excel or CSV file
imporPiutang.pickFileHint: Column headings are recognised automatically. The file is read in this browser and sent nowhere.
imporPiutang.noSisaColumn: This file has no outstanding column. Every invoice is treated as wholly unpaid — outstanding equals the full amount.
imporPiutang.previewHint: Amber rows will not be imported. The reason is in the last column.
imporPiutang.historyLocked: Already in use — cannot be reverted
imporPiutang.revertBody: {count} invoices will be deleted. If even one is already on a collection note or settled by a claim, the whole revert is refused.
imporPiutang.revertReasonPlaceholder: e.g. columns swapped, wrong period, same file uploaded twice
imporPiutang.revertInUse: Cannot revert: these invoices are already in use — {list}
imporPiutang.revertErrTIDAK_DITEMUKAN: That import record was not found.
imporPiutang.revertErrBUKAN_IMPOR: That record is not an import.
imporPiutang.revertErrTANPA_AKSES: You are not allowed to revert an import.
imporPiutang.skipBARIS_BERMASALAH: Something in this row could not be read.
imporPiutang.skipTOKO_TIDAK_DITEMUKAN: The shop code or name matches no shop.
imporPiutang.skipTOKO_KONSI: Consignment shop. Goods there are still ours until they sell, so no receivable is born from it.
imporPiutang.skipLUNAS: Outstanding is zero — the invoice is settled and needs no receivable.
imporPiutang.errJudulTidakKetemu: No heading row found in the first 20 rows.
imporPiutang.errKolomWajib: An invoice number and an amount column are required. Check the headings.
imporPiutang.errBacaBerkas: The file could not be read. Make sure it is Excel or CSV.
imporPiutang.errTANPA_AKSES: You do not have access to import invoices.

fakturManual.title: Manual invoice
fakturManual.body: Type an invoice that did not arrive in a file. Add the item lines if you have them — those are what can be checked against the shop's copy later.
fakturManual.itemsHint: May be left empty. If filled, the invoice amount is computed from it.
fakturManual.errTANPA_AKSES: You do not have access to create invoices.
fakturManual.errTANGGAL_TIDAK_VALID: The date could not be read.
fakturManual.errTOKO_KONSI: A consignment shop creates no receivable — the goods are still ours until they sell.
fakturManual.errNILAI_TIDAK_VALID: The invoice amount must be more than zero.
fakturManual.errTEMPO_SEBELUM_FAKTUR: The due date cannot come before the invoice date.

dasborPelunasan.pageDescription: What is holding money today, and whose turn it is.
dasborPelunasan.todoHint: Ordered by risk. Click a row to work on it.
dasborPelunasan.todoEmptyBody: No overdue invoices, no waiting claims, no unfinished returns.
dasborPelunasan.why_lewat: {toko} — {hari} days past the promise and the money has not arrived.
dasborPelunasan.why_klaim: {toko} — reported {hari} days ago, not yet matched against the statement.
dasborPelunasan.why_tertahan: {toko} — the return deduction does not match what the warehouse received.
dasborPelunasan.why_cek: {toko} — the goods are not recorded as received.
dasborPelunasan.why_keputusan: {toko} — the warehouse received less than claimed and nobody bears it.
dasborPelunasan.why_jodoh: Goods arrived with no shop note and need matching.
dasborPelunasan.photoOrphan: {count} of them belong to no document ({size}) — swept automatically each night.
dasborPelunasan.why_lewat_today: {toko} — the promise falls today and the money has not arrived.
dasborPelunasan.why_klaim_today: {toko} — reported today, not yet matched against the statement.
dasborPelunasan.why_tertahan_today: {toko} — the return deduction does not match what the warehouse received.
dasborPelunasan.why_cek_today: {toko} — the goods are not recorded as received.
dasborPelunasan.why_keputusan_today: {toko} — the warehouse received less than claimed and nobody bears it.
dasborPelunasan.why_jodoh_today: Goods arrived with no shop note and need matching.

bebanSelisih.pageDescription: The gap between a shop's return claim and the warehouse count, and who carries it.
bebanSelisih.emptyBody: Every counted return matches what its shop claimed.
bebanSelisih.explain: While a difference is carried by nobody it holds the related invoice open. Assigning it releases the invoice; recovering the money runs on its own, and that is what “paid back” records as finished.
bebanSelisih.errTANPA_AKSES: You do not have access to this action.
bebanSelisih.errBELUM_DIPUTUSKAN: This has not been assigned yet.
bebanSelisih.errSUDAH_LUNAS: This is already marked paid back.
bebanSelisih.reassignBody: Change who carries it. A charge already paid back cannot be moved — moving it would make that payment record a lie.
bebanSelisih.orphanWarning: {count} charges are assigned to a salesman without naming one. Until that is fixed they appear on nobody's screen — reassign to complete them.

pwaPiutang.why_klaim: You reported a transfer on {doc}. Finance has not seen the money arrive yet, so it does not count as settled.
pwaPiutang.why_tertahan: {value} held by a return — the deduction does not match what the warehouse received. The invoice cannot reach zero until the difference is resolved.
pwaPiutang.why_lewat: The shop promised {date} — {days} days past and the money has not arrived. Chase it and get a new date.
pwaPiutang.why_tt: On collection note {doc}. The shop promised {date} — wait for the date.
pwaPiutang.why_belum: Ready for a collection note — nothing hanging and nothing overdue.

pwaBkm.why_DIKIRIM: Reported. Finance has not matched it against the bank statement yet, so the receivable has not dropped.
pwaBkm.why_DIBATALKAN: This report was voided because it was entered wrong, not because the money was missing.
pwaBkm.why_giro_MENUNGGU: The giro has not cleared yet. The receivable only drops once it clears into the account and finance records it.

pwaRetur.empty: You have not recorded any return notes.
pwaRetur.why_cek: Waiting for the warehouse to count. Until then the deduction is not recognised.
pwaRetur.why_keputusan: The warehouse received less than the shop claimed. Finance is deciding who bears the difference.
pwaRetur.why_jodoh: Not yet matched to a warehouse receipt.
pwaRetur.why_beres: Done — claim and physical agree, or the difference has been borne.
pwaRetur.newBody: Photograph the note first, then copy its number and value from the photo.
pwaRetur.photoHint: Required. This photo is what the archive is made of and what the warehouse looks at when counting.
pwaRetur.noNrtHint: Copy it exactly from the shop's note, not one of ours.
pwaRetur.errTANPA_AKSES: You do not have access to record return notes.
pwaRetur.errTANGGAL_TIDAK_VALID: The date could not be read.
pwaRetur.errNOMOR_SUDAH_DIPAKAI: That note number is already used for this shop.
pwaRetur.errNILAI_TIDAK_VALID: The value must be more than zero.
pwaRetur.okQueued: Saved on the phone. The return note sends by itself once there is a signal.
pwaRetur.errKUNCI_DIPAKAI: This note clashes with another salesperson's upload. Photograph it again.
pwaRetur.kurangFoto: Take a photo of the return note first.
pwaRetur.kurangNomor: Fill in the store's note number.
pwaRetur.kurangNilai: Fill in the amount the store claims.
pwaRetur.salinan: Copied from {doc}. The number, amount, date and photo (if any) are filled in — check them, then choose the right store.
pwaRetur.errPENGGANTI_TIDAK_DITEMUKAN: The note to replace was not found.
pwaRetur.errPENGGANTI_MASIH_BERLAKU: The old note is still active. Withdraw it before recording again.
pwaRetur.errPENGGANTI_BUKAN_MILIK: The old note is not yours.
pwaRetur.errSUDAH_DIGANTI: The old note already has a replacement — the same goods cannot be reported twice.
pwaRetur.errTOKO_TIDAK_DIIZINKAN: You may not record a return for this store.
pwaRetur.errBARANG_TIDAK_DITEMUKAN: Some goods were not recognised. Choose them again.
pwaRetur.errFOTO_WAJIB: Take a photo of the store's return note first.
pwaRetur.errRUSAK_TIDAK_SAH: These damaged delivery goods cannot be sent back from this store (not yet decided by the warehouse, not this store's, or a different item).
pwaRetur.errRUSAK_MELEBIHI: The quantity sent back exceeds the damaged pieces not yet returned.
pwaRetur.errRETUR_PEMBELI_TIDAK_SAH: This shopper-returned damaged item cannot be sent back from this store (not this store's shopper return, a different item, or its condition is sellable).
pwaRetur.errRETUR_PEMBELI_MELEBIHI: The quantity sent back exceeds the shopper-returned damaged pieces not yet sent.

pwaBeban.empty: No return difference is charged to you.
pwaBeban.whyOpen: This difference is charged to you and has not been paid back.

pwaGudang.countBody: {doc} — the shop claims {claimed}. Enter the value of what actually arrived.
pwaGudang.countHint: Zero is valid and means nothing arrived. It can only be recorded once.
pwaGudang.errTANPA_AKSES: You do not have access to count returns.
pwaGudang.errTANGGAL_TIDAK_VALID: The date could not be read.
pwaGudang.errSUDAH_DIHITUNG: This note has already been counted.
pwaGudang.perBarisHint: Count each line: the quantity that arrived and its condition.
pwaGudang.tidakMasukStok: Does not go into sellable stock.
pwaGudang.nilaiPerBarisHint: Filled in from the line counts. You may change it — the figure saved is the one written here.

konsinyasi.pageDescription: One cycle = one shop × one month. Each row names its stage and whose turn it is.
konsinyasi.summary: {count} cycles · {late} SPG salaries past their date
konsinyasi.lateWarning: {count} cycles have an SPG salary past its date. This is the one that gets forgotten.
konsinyasi.why_laporan: One of the two reports has not arrived. With only one there is nothing to compare.
konsinyasi.why_cocok: Both reports are in but the figures are not locked. There is no official number yet.
konsinyasi.why_bayar_spg: Figures are locked; the SPG commission has not been paid.
konsinyasi.why_nota: Salary settled. The sales admin has not issued a nota.
konsinyasi.why_pajak: The nota exists. The tax admin has not recorded the tax invoice number.
konsinyasi.why_selesai: Chain complete — all three numbers present.
konsinyasi.emptyBody: Open a cycle for a consignment shop for the month you want to reconcile.
konsinyasi.spgDueHint: Its own date, separate from every other deadline — so the SPG salary stops losing to noisier work.
konsinyasi.openCycleBody: One cycle per shop per month. Every report, the official figures, and all three document numbers hang off it.
konsinyasi.shipBody: Goods sent to a consignment shop. Consigned stock is shipped minus sold.
konsinyasi.threeNumbersHint: They may be entirely unrelated. Side by side here so nobody has to ask which nota number it was.
konsinyasi.compareHint: The SPG reports by email, the shop by carrier. Red rows differ, or appear in only one report.
konsinyasi.reportBody: Copy it as it stands. Corrections happen when the figures are locked, not here.
konsinyasi.lockBody: These figures — not either raw report — bill the shop, pay the commission and reduce consigned stock. Prefilled from the SPG report; correct what needs correcting.
konsinyasi.baseSalaryHint: Base salary is whole for each; only the commission is split.
konsinyasi.commissionFromMaster: The per-piece commission rate is taken from the item master at lock time and copied onto the official line — changing the rate next month does not change this month's commission.
konsinyasi.openCharge: Still owes {value} in return charges — consider netting it off this commission.
konsinyasi.stockHint: Shipped minus sold. Derived, not stored.
konsinyasi.stockEmpty: Nothing has been shipped to this shop yet.
konsinyasi.recordNotaBody: The sales admin's number. It may be entirely unrelated to ours.
konsinyasi.errTANPA_AKSES: You do not have access to this action.
konsinyasi.errTANGGAL_TIDAK_VALID: The date could not be read.
konsinyasi.errTOKO_BUKAN_KONSI: That shop is not a consignment shop.
konsinyasi.errSIKLUS_SUDAH_ADA: A cycle for that shop and month already exists.
konsinyasi.errPERIODE_TIDAK_VALID: That month or year is not valid.
konsinyasi.errSUDAH_DIKUNCI: The figures are locked. Unlock them first.
konsinyasi.errBELUM_DIKUNCI: The figures are not locked yet.
konsinyasi.errLAPORAN_BELUM_LENGKAP: Both reports must arrive first — locking on one means locking a figure that was never compared to anything.
konsinyasi.errADA_GAJI_SUDAH_DIBAYAR: A salary has already been paid. Unlocking after that means the commission could be recomputed smaller than what is already in someone's pocket.
konsinyasi.errNILAI_TIDAK_VALID: One of the figures is not valid.
konsinyasi.errSUDAH_DIBAYAR: This salary is already marked paid.

spgFill.hint: Fill in from the SPG sales receipts for this store in the cycle month. The rows below are replaced — check them, then save.
spgFill.empty: No SPG sales recorded for this month yet.
spgFill.done: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} filled in from SPG sales. Check, then save.

konsinyasi.matchHint: Sales in the store stock book compared with the SPG report and the store report. Only for cycles not locked yet.

tagihan.title: Bill to the store
tagihan.hint: Official sales minus the promo discount Elorae carries, plus the lost-goods charge assigned to the store.
tagihan.loss: Lost goods charged to the store
tagihan.totalAfterLock: Available once the figures are locked
tagihan.promoLive: Calculated live from this month's SPG receipts; frozen when locked.
tagihan.promoChanged: This month's SPG receipts changed after locking — the receipts now give an Elorae discount of {value}. The bill keeps the frozen figure; unlock to recalculate.
tagihan.storeShare: The store's share of a promo reduces the store's own margin and does not change the bill.
tagihan.lockPreview: The promo discount Elorae carries ({promo}) is frozen too — bill to the store {total}, before any lost-goods charge.

cocokBuku.title: Stock book reconciliation
cocokBuku.hint: The store stock book (kept by the SPG) compared with the consignment sales reports, per product. Sizes and colours are merged because the reports only go down to the product.
cocokBuku.diff: {count, plural, one {# product differs} other {# products differ}}
cocokBuku.noBook: This store does not use the stock book yet — only the SPG report, the store report and the official figures are compared.
cocokBuku.bookStarted: The store stock book only started on {date} — sales from the book cover that date onwards.
cocokBuku.lost: {count, plural, one {# product} other {# products}} possibly lost, {pcs} pcs. Figures only — lost goods are recorded separately.
cocokBuku.notaHint: SPG receipts (net, by receipt date) are for comparison only and do not decide a difference.
cocokBuku.stockHint: Expected at the store = consigned stock − in process: shipments the SPG has not received, returns the warehouse has not counted, and goods damaged on arrival that have not entered the book.
cocokBuku.provisional: Months not locked yet use provisional figures: {months}.
cocokBuku.recordedLostHint: Goods already recorded lost from a stock count or a short delivery are not counted again as possibly lost.

jenisPotongan.pageDescription: The deductions allowed on a payment claim, and the rules attached to each.
jenisPotongan.methodHint_PERSEN: The amount is a percentage of the invoice.
jenisPotongan.methodHint_DARI_RETUR: MUST be linked to a return note. That link is what holds the amount until the warehouse finishes counting — without this type, linking depends entirely on whoever is typing remembering to.
jenisPotongan.ruleNoteHint: A deduction of this type cannot be saved without an explanation.
jenisPotongan.rulePkpHint: A marker only — Elorae has no taxable flag on a shop, so nothing enforces it yet.
jenisPotongan.ruleManualHint: When off, this type may only arrive from another process, not be typed by an admin.
jenisPotongan.ruleActiveHint: Inactive types do not appear when creating a claim, but stay attached to older ones.
jenisPotongan.formBody: The rules chosen here are enforced when a claim is saved, not merely displayed.
jenisPotongan.emptyBody: While the list is empty, deduction names are typed freehand on every claim.
jenisPotongan.explain: Types are NOT deleted, only disabled. One that has been used stays attached to older claims, and deleting it would strip the name off historical deductions — old reports would change after being closed.
jenisPotongan.errTANPA_AKSES: You do not have access to change deduction types.
jenisPotongan.errNAMA_SUDAH_ADA: That name is already used by another type.

ocr.hint: The lines are read from the note photo. These are proposals — check them before using.
ocr.nothingRead: Nothing readable in this photo. Type it in by hand.
ocr.lowConfidence: The photo is unclear ({pct}% confident). If much of it is wrong, retake it brighter and straighter — that is faster than fixing line by line.
ocr.totalDiffers: Note total {total}, selected {selected} — something was missed or misread.

ocr.errTANPA_AKSES: You are not allowed to read this photo.
ocr.errGAGAL: Could not read the photo. Type it in by hand.

creative.contentDescription: Instagram and TikTok content plans — from idea to live.
creative.contentEmptyBody: Start with one idea. Its status can move back and forth until it goes live.
creative.kolDescription: Who you have worked with and can work with, and their accounts.
creative.kolEmptyBody: Add one, with their accounts and follower counts.
creative.newKolHint: Tier is derived from the largest follower count — no need to set it.
creative.briefDescription: Assignments to a KOL: deliverables, fee, and the product sent.
creative.briefEmptyBody: Create a brief to assign content to a KOL.
creative.briefEmptyNoKol: Add a KOL first, in the KOL Directory tab.
creative.newBriefHint: Saved as a draft. Product only leaves the warehouse when the brief is sent.
creative.briefTextPlaceholder: Talking points, tone of voice, hashtags…
creative.goodsHint: Stock is deducted when the brief is SENT, not now. A draft can still change.
creative.kpiFeeCommittedHint: Not spent yet — recognised when the content goes live.
creative.confirmSendWithStock: {qty} items will LEAVE the warehouse now, and cancelling later will not bring them back.
creative.confirmCancelAfterSent: The product has already gone to the KOL. Cancelling does NOT return the stock — the goods stay gone.
creative.okSentWithStock: Brief sent. {qty} items left the warehouse.
creative.errSTATUS_TIDAK_VALID: That status cannot be reached from the current one.
creative.errTANPA_DELIVERABLE: A brief needs at least one deliverable.
creative.errBARANG_TIDAK_DITEMUKAN: That item has no inventory record.
creative.errTANPA_AKSES: You are not allowed to do this.
creative.imageHint: This is what shows in the grid. A mockup is fine — it need not be the final asset.
creative.deleteBody: “{judul}” will be deleted. Its image is swept a few hours later unless another post uses it.
creative.deleteManyBody: All of them go at once. Their images are swept a few hours later unless another post uses them.

token.loadError: Could not load the token state. Make sure apps/api is running.

spgRequests.readOnly: You can only view. Changing a status needs the manage-stores permission.
spgRequests.count: {count, plural, =0 {no requests} one {# request} other {# requests}}
spgRequests.emptyActive: Every request has been handled. New ones appear here as soon as an SPG sends one from their phone.
spgRequests.emptyOther: No requests with this status yet.

spgLostSales.capNote: Only the 500 most recent records in this period are counted.
spgLostSales.summaryHint: Records with the same description are added together, ignoring upper and lower case.
spgLostSales.count: {count, plural, =0 {no records} one {# record} other {# records}}
spgLostSales.emptyBody: SPGs record it from their phone (More → Items asked for) whenever a customer asks for an item or size the store does not have.

storeProposals.title: New store proposals
storeProposals.subtitle: Prospective stores found by salespeople in the field, waiting to be registered.
storeProposals.dupBody: Recomputed now against every store (including inactive ones) and other proposals still waiting.
storeProposals.dupNone: No similar store or other proposal.
storeProposals.approveBody: Tidy up the fields if needed. The store is created right away with the location and details from the field, and the proposing salesperson is notified.
storeProposals.codeHint: Suggested: the next code in the pattern in use. Must be unique.
storeProposals.holderHint: Default: the salesperson who proposed it.
storeProposals.pkpHint: Decides whether the PPh 23 deduction may be used on this store's payment receipts.

aturan.judul: How promos are applied at the counter
aturan.pengantar: Several promos can run at once. This is the order the sale screen and the receipt use:
aturan.satu: One piece gets at most one product promo (percentage off, rupiah off, special price, or buy X get Y free).
aturan.prioritas: Higher priority goes first. At the same priority each piece gets the biggest discount; buy X get Y free then uses the pieces left over.
aturan.paket: Buy X get Y free may mix products in that promo: pieces are sorted from the most expensive, and in every full group of X+Y the Y cheapest pieces are free.
aturan.belanja: After product promos, at most ONE minimum-spend promo — the one with the biggest discount — is applied to the net value of the products in that promo.
aturan.manual: The SPG's manual discount (when switched on in Settings → SPG) comes last, on the receipt's net value, and cannot exceed its percentage limit.
aturan.waktu: A promo is judged at the time of sale: a receipt made without signal and sent the next morning still gets that day's promo.

kinerjaSpg.deskripsi: Attendance, sales, visitors and day closing for every SPG in one month. Read by the SPG supervisors to assess and coach; the figures come from the SPG phones and the shift schedule.
kinerjaSpg.kosongIsi: No SPG held a store, recorded a receipt, was scheduled, or counted visitors this month.
kinerjaSpg.kosongSaringIsi: This store has no SPG or SPG activity this month. Pick another month or store.

sel.tanpaTarget: No target set for this month
sel.belumDisusun: No shift schedule has been made for this SPG at this store

keterangan.jadwal: Scheduled, Present, Late and Absent count up to today from the shift schedule (SPG → Schedule). A dash means no schedule was made for that SPG at that store, not zero.
keterangan.terlambat: Late: first check-in more than the shift start + {menit} minutes; minutes are counted from the shift start.
keterangan.izin: Leave: working days with approved leave, sick leave or annual leave on which the SPG did not come in.
keterangan.nilai: Receipts, pieces and value from that SPG's receipts at that store, net of goods shoppers returned.
keterangan.pengunjung: Visitors from the counter on the SPG phone. Days without a count use the day-closing figure, split evenly among the SPGs present — marked *.
keterangan.konversi: Conversion: receipts ÷ visitors, only on days with a visitor figure.
keterangan.target: Target reached: the SPG's net sales at all their stores ÷ their monthly target (Settings → Salesman → Target).
keterangan.tutup: Day closing: days with a day-closing report ÷ days the SPG sold.
keterangan.titip: Customer requests: created by the SPG this month, and how many are done.
keterangan.retur: Shopper returns: pieces returned by shoppers ÷ pieces on this month's receipts.

pengaturanBarangHilang.penjelasan: Missing goods are sometimes borne by the store, an SPG, a salesperson or Elorae — finance decides each case under SPG → Missing goods. This card sets how they are valued and how much may be deducted from one salary/commission payment.

dasarIsi.HARGA_ELORAE: The item's selling price in the master. The same for every store.
dasarIsi.HPP: The warehouse average cost — only Elorae's capital loss.
dasarIsi.ECERAN: The shelf price: selling price at outright stores, grossed up by the store margin at consignment stores.
dasarIsi.HARGA_TERIMA: The price at which that store last received the item. Outright store: the delivery note (net of line discounts). Consignment store: the in-store price less the store margin — 100,000 at a 25% margin becomes 75,000. Default.

pengaturanBarangHilang.dasarCatatan: The value is frozen when the record opens. The office may still change the total when deciding, with a reason.
pengaturanBarangHilang.persenIsi: At most {persen}% of one salary/commission payment is deducted for missing goods. The rest is carried into later payments, so one incident never wipes out a salary.
pengaturanBarangHilang.persenSalah: Enter a whole number from 0 to 100.
pengaturanBarangHilang.opnameLabel: Short consignment stock counts open a record
pengaturanBarangHilang.opnameIsi: Whenever an SPG counts fewer than the stock book at a consignment store, a missing-goods record opens for a decision. Outright stores do not — the goods belong to the store.
pengaturanBarangHilang.tanpaIzin: Only finance (receivables: manage) can change these rules.
